name: Gograph
description: Local AST-aware Go repository analysis for coding agents. Provides 61 query, analysis, and workflow capabilities (65 MCP endpoints including session lifecycle) covering call graphs, impact, interfaces, type usage, security-flow candidates, architecture policies, diagrams, error flow, and local workflow telemetry.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `gograph` (Go repository intelligence for Claude Code).

Installs with `claude plugin install gograph@claude-community` from `ozgurcd/gograph`.

Give Go coding agents a compiler-aware map for safer refactors.

Local AST-aware Go repository analysis for coding agents. Provides 61 query, analysis, and workflow capabilities (65 MCP endpoints including session lifecycle) covering call graphs, impact, interfaces, type usage, security-flow candidates, architecture policies, diagrams, error flow, and local workflow telemetry.
